items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4 diagnostic, corrected denominator): context-conditioned (reef vs open) committed-class TV-divergence, ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF -- supersedes V3-EXQ-847
items.note: arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing) + the 2026-08-02 active_frac denominator sweep addendum. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-847: chip chip-20260802-v3exq847a-queue, redesign of V3-EXQ-847 per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-847_2026-08-01.md (confirmed, governance-ratified 2026-08-01T22:24:00Z). BUG FIXED: 847's mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms / mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms readiness preconditions computed active_frac = fresh-only-numerator / n_p2_ticks (ALL P2 ticks incl. held/replayed commitments) -- a basis mismatch that deflated active_frac by the held-tick fraction (40-86% across 847's 6 cells) and produced a FALSE substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route even though MECH-448/449 were actually 100% active on genuine fresh selections (847's own manifest recomputes to exactly 1.0 against n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks). FIX: both demotion_active_frac and nogo_active_frac now divide by n_p2_fresh_select = n_p2_ticks - n_latched_ticks, matching sibling script V3-EXQ-859's reference-correct pattern. Purely a post-hoc aggregation fix; training loop / RNG seeding / env dynamics / ARMS / hyperparameters unchanged from V3-EXQ-847. SEED SET UNCHANGED [42, 43, 44] (deliberate, investigated this build -- see script docstring PREMISE CORRECTION section): no third documented-good seed exists to substitute for degenerate seed 44 (a standalone env probe this session confirmed the seed-44 degeneracy is a TRAINED-POLICY property, not raw env geometry, so an untested seed cannot be cheaply pre-verified); seeds 42+43 alone satisfy C1g's majority-of-3 floor; extra seeds were not added since MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS/TV_MIN_LIFT_SEEDS are fixed absolute counts, not proportions, so adding seeds without rescaling would silently loosen every C1 subgate's majority semantics. EXPECTED OUTCOME (stated in advance): because the fix is aggregation-only and seeds/config are unchanged, this run is expected to reproduce 847's own already-known DVs (seed 43 bit-identical washout across arms, seed 44 zero reef ticks/self-excludes, seed 42 the only informative cell showing a lift OPPOSITE H4's hypothesis) -- verdict likely FAIL / non_contributory / context_divergence_not_greater_arm_on_measurement_aliasing_ruled_out. The point of this re-run is to let the readiness gate correctly recognize MECH-448/449 as live so the pipeline computes the C1/C2/C3 verdict end-to-end itself, rather than the correction living only as a hand-annotated autopsy note. Smoke (--dry-run, seed 42 only): confirmed the fix -- f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac / go_nogo_active_frac read 1.0 (28 fresh / 28 fresh, excluding 24 of 52 P2 ticks as latched) vs the old deflated ~0.538 that would have failed the 0.8 floor; demotion_non_vacuous / nogo_non_vacuous both True at toy scale. C1/C1g/C2 still read False at dry-run dose, as expected (1 seed of 3, toy episode budget -- same documented dry-run behaviour as V3-EXQ-847 itself). GOV-REUSE-1: the H4 primary DV was already reanalyzed by hand from 847's manifest in the autopsy (no re-run needed for THAT); this run exists so the corrected readiness gate + full C1-C3 pipeline runs natively, per the autopsy's own routing recommendation.

items.title: MECH-122 spindle content-selection validation of V3-EXQ-861 spindle_density DV (MECH-180)

items.title: MECH-480: dACC-analog execution-gain dissociation -- outcome-sensitivity vs logit-margin execution strength under dacc_weight OFF/ON ablation with mid-episode contingency switch (EXP-0413, dacc_bias_max_abs clamp fix)
items.note: Diagnosed via /diagnose-errors 2026-08-02. V3-EXQ-870 crashed ERROR (RuntimeError: probability tensor contains inf/nan/negative element, e3_selector.py:3498 torch.multinomial) during Seed 42 Condition ON, P1 ep 20/90, on ree-cloud-4 (traceback recovered from the ree-runner systemd journal -- crash predates any manifest write, no run pack exists). ROOT CAUSE: 870 carried DACC_WEIGHT=3.0/DACC_PRECISION_SCALE=500.0 from v3_exq_450's calibration but left dacc_bias_max_abs at its default (0.0 = unclamped). Traced through DACCtoE3Adapter.forward + e3_selector.py: with dacc_weight>=1.0 unclamped this is a POSITIVE FEEDBACK loop, not just a magnitude knob -- the dACC bias's mode_ev term is fed from payoffs=-e3.last_scores, and last_scores is the PREVIOUS tick's already-biased composed score (dacc_score_bias is added into scores before self.last_scores=scores.detach() is set). So bias_N ~= dacc_weight * bias_{N-1} in the dominant-term limit -- with dacc_weight=3.0 that is unconditionally divergent (gain>1). v3_exq_450 used the identical unclamped config and PASSED, which is NOT evidence the config is safe -- only that that run's seed/length combination did not surface the divergence before P1 ended. FIX: added DACC_BIAS_MAX_ABS=2.0 (the v3_exq_445g/445h/597/597b precedent value -- "the range where E3 softmax can actually discriminate candidates", per 445g's docstring) to the REEConfig.from_dims() call, which truncates the bias every tick and so cannot diverge regardless of dacc_weight. DACC_WEIGHT/DACC_PRECISION_SCALE and every other constant, phase, and threshold are UNCHANGED from 870, so the calibrated effect size (the magnitude v3_exq_450 found necessary to shift E3's argmax) is preserved -- only the runaway tail is cut. Added a preflight regression-guard assertion that the clamp actually reaches agent.dacc_adapter.config.dacc_bias_max_abs (from_dims has a known failure mode where an unwired kwarg is silently swallowed -- see ree-v3/CLAUDE.md from_dims memory note -- which would silently re-arm this exact divergence). Code review (Step 4d) + smoke test (--dry-run, 1 seed x 2 conditions, tiny P1=4/P2=2/steps=20/switch=10) 2026-08-02: preflight PASS including the new clamp-reached assertion, both conditions ran cleanly to completion with no crash, n_genuine_selections>0 asserted and confirmed in both arms. claim_ids unchanged from 870 (user-confirmed 2026-08-02): the fix is a numerical-stability clamp only and does not change what MECH-480 hypothesis is being tested. supersedes=V3-EXQ-870 (ERROR, crash-before-manifest, no manifest to mark superseded via governance -- the synthetic ERROR record v3_v3_exq_870_runner_error_20260802T105035Z_v3 is the only artifact; evidence_direction already non_contributory).
